question: The graph of the inverse proportional function \(y=k/x\) passes through the points \(A(2,m)\) and \(B(-3,6)\). Find the value of \(m\).
solution: Using B gives \(k=-3\times6=-18\), so \(y=-18/x\). At point A, \(m=-18/2=-9\).
